preflight_deg.note: You press mode. Row 1: the highlighted word is your angle mode. You want DEG.
If DEG is not lit, move to it with the arrows, press enter, then clear (or 2nd mode = quit). Real example photo showed RAD and ENG on screen.

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: You press 2nd, then sin (num-solv is printed above sin). It asks for the equation.
Left side: 165 d x-squared minus 2.712 d. Press the x yzt abcd key until d shows.
Press enter, then type the right side.
Type 0.0334, enter. The next screen lists every letter with its stored value. Edit the value of d to your guess (0.05); this is the starting guess.
R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.source_loc: video still: ENTER AND SOLVE / X=0.8 / SOLVE: X

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: Type 0.05 for d, make sure SOLVE: shows d, press enter. L - R near 0 means a good answer.
R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.source_loc: solution photo shows this layout for X

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: For the other root choose SOLVE AGAIN and use -0.05 as the guess. How the guess is typed on that screen is not shown (UNVERIFIED).

R1_alt_quadratic_direct.note: Press enter to pick the quadratic. Type a (guide example uses 1).
DOWN, then b. Negative numbers use the (-) key.
DOWN, then c; SOLVE shows at the bottom right.
DOWN for x2. For 165, -2.712, -0.0334 expect x1=0.02465 and x2=-0.00821 (hand-checked, not a guide screen).

press: x y z t a b c d (until g letter shows: use a)
R2_store_dont_retype__g_and_M.note: Press the x y z t a b c d key until your letter shows (here a).
Press enter. The value is saved. Do the same for mass M in letter b.
To use it later: 2nd then sto-> (recall), pick the letter, enter.
ans chain: 2nd then (-) (answer is printed above it), or press an operator first.

preflight_deg.note: You press mode. You want DEG highlighted.
Move to DEG, press enter, then clear.

press: x y z t a b c (5 presses = a)
R1_store_then_formula__quadratic.note: Store 165 in a: type 165, press sto->, press the letter key until a shows, press enter.

press: x y z t a b c (6 presses = b)
R1_store_then_formula__quadratic.note: Store b the same way. Use the (-) key for the minus sign.

press: x y z t a b c (7 presses = c)

R1_store_then_formula__quadratic.note: Type the formula once with the letters: (-b + sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a). Letters come from the same key, or 2nd recall. This sequence is composed from verified pieces, not shown whole in the guide. This is the slower fallback; the 30XS has no solver.
For the other root, go back (up arrow) and change + to -.

press: x y z t a b c
R2_store_dont_retype__g_and_M.note: Type 9.80, sto->, press the letter key until x shows, enter. Guide screen shows 15->x then 15.
Later: 2nd recall, pick the letter, enter.
Use the last answer by starting with an operator.

preflight_deg.note: You press SHIFT, MODE (SETUP), then 3 for Deg.

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: Type the whole equation. X is ALPHA then the ) key. The = sign is ALPHA then CALC. (Unknown is called X on this model.) Use LineIO-style input while solving.
Press SHIFT then CALC (SOLVE). It may ask for other letters first (shows "Y?"-style prompts); press = to accept each. Then "Solve for X" shows the starting value.
R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.source_loc: Using SOLVE; screens SOLVE_9 and SOLVE_10

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: Type your guess 0.05, press =. The answer screen shows X= and L-R=. L-R near 0 means a good answer. Expected X=0.02465.
R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.source_loc: screen layout from SOLVE_4 (example numbers differ)

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: To find the other root: press SHIFT CALC again, press = on the prompts, type -0.05 and =. Expected X=-0.00821. SOLVE returns only ONE root, the one near your guess.

R2_store_dont_retype__g_and_M.note: Type 9.80, press SHIFT, RCL (STO), then the (-) key (that key is A).
Store the mass in M with SHIFT RCL M+.
Use them: ALPHA (-) is A; RCL M+ gives M. The Ans key chains answers.

preflight_deg.note: You press SHIFT, MODE (SETUP), then 3 for Deg.
preflight_deg.source_loc: fx-300ES PLUS manual: Configuring the Calculator Setup

R1_store_then_formula__quadratic.note: Store a in A: 165, SHIFT RCL (STO), (-) key.
Store b in B with the key printed with B (the degrees-minutes-seconds key).
Store c in C (hyp key is C).
Type (-B + sqrt(B^2 - 4AC)) / (2A), =. Slower fallback: this model has no EQN and no SOLVE. Replay (LEFT) lets you change + to - for the other root.

preflight_deg.note: You press the SETTINGS key (sliders icon). Pick Calc Settings > Angle Unit > Degree.

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: Press HOME, pick Equation, press OK.
Pick Solver, press OK.
Type the whole equation. The unknown is x (the x key). The = sign is SHIFT then the ( key. Press EXE to register it.
EXE registers it. On Solve Target confirm x, press OK.
Type 0.05 as the starting x, EXE, then with [Execute] selected press EXE. Answer shows x= and (Left Side)-(Right Side) near 0. Only ONE root. For the other root press back (return key) and use -0.05.

R2_store_dont_retype__g_and_M.note: Press the variables key, pick [A=] then [Store].

preflight_deg.note: You press SHIFT, MENU (SETUP). Pick Angle Unit by its number on screen, then 1 for Degree.

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: Type the whole equation. x is ALPHA then ) . The = is ALPHA then CALC.
Press SHIFT then CALC (SOLVE). A list shows the letters and their values.
Type your guess for x (guide uses 1 =). The initial value of x is the starting guess.
R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.source_loc: guide p.19 ("Input an initial value for x")

R1_solve_one_equation__energy_for_d.note: Move the highlight to x with UP, press =. Answer shows x= and L-R=. Near 0 is good. Expected 0.02465.
Other root: SOLVE again with -0.05. SOLVE gives only one root, the one near your guess.

R2_store_dont_retype__g_and_M.note: Type 9.80, press STO, then the (-) key (A). Guide: 3+5 STO (-)(A) gives 8.
Store the mass in M: value, STO, M+ key.
Use letters: ALPHA (-) is A. SHIFT STO (RECALL) lists all stored values.
